'''Airscrews''' are a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Crude Parasites|Crude]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns in groups of 1 to 2, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]] onward, with a spawnweight of 5.
* This mob will only spawn within the range of a [[Colony]].

== ''Behavior'' ==

*Airscrews can shoot a projectile which creates [[Thin Webbing]] upon landing. These will slow down their target. These Webs disappear, after enough time passes.
**They can shoot three of these projectiles at a time at multiple targets.
**If this web projectile successfully hits a mob, a rope will be formed that will pull it up towards the Airscrew's underside, where it will receive immense damage.
***When a mob is being pulled by this rope, it will receive:
****Mining Fatigue III and Slowness III for the duration it is being pulled.
****Weakness III for two seconds.
***If this rope passes through a solid block, it will break and the target will no longer be pulled.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
Airscrews, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

==''Trivia''==
*Airscrews are known as '''Leer''' in the mod files.
*In the [https://trello.com/c/EuhDjVH4/770-airscrew Trello] it mentions the Airscrew patrolling near [[Nests]] and/or [[Colony|Colonies]].
*Despite having a head hitbox, it is unable to receive melee damage, nor does it give any bonus damage if hit with a projectile.
